{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=8|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[2019 Western Libya offensive]]
**Forces loyal to the [[Government of National Accord]] retake [[Tripoli International Airport]] from the [[Libyan National Army]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/libyan-govt-forces-retake-tripoli-airport-from-haftar/1445449 (Anadolu Agency)]
**One of the vice chairmen of the GNA [[Presidential Council (Libya)|Presidential Council]], [[Ali Faraj Qatrani]], defects to the [[House of Representatives (Libya)|Tobruk-based government]]. [https://aawsat.com/english/home/article/1669676/sarraj-deputy-quits-voices-support-libyan-national-army (Asharq Al-Awsat)]
**A warplane loyal to [[Khalifa Haftar]], reported to be a [[Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-23|MiG-23]], strikes [[Mitiga International Airport]], the only functional airport in [[Tripoli]]. A LNA spokesman says civilian planes were not targeted in the air raid. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/08/eu-uk-urges-france-to-condemn-khalifa-haftar-assault-on-tripoli (''The Guardian'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**A roadside bomb kills three [[United States|U.S.]] troops and one civilian contractor near [[Bagram Airfield]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-47860816 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[United States Postal Service|U.S. Postal Service]] announces that they will issue a new commemorative stamp to honor the late President [[George H. W. Bush]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/us-postal-service-announces-forever-stamp-honoring-late/story?id=62233668 (ABC News)]
*''[[The Nation]]''{{'s}} editor [[Katrina vanden Heuvel]] announces that she will step down as editor after 24 years, on June 15, 2019. ''The Nation'' is the oldest continuously published weekly magazine in the United States. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/08/business/media/katrina-vanden-heuvel-the-nation.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Animal welfare and rights in Australia]]
**Radical [[Veganism|vegans]] stage a nationwide protest against animal cruelty in [[Australia]]. In the city of [[Melbourne]], protesting vegans blocked a major intersection for four hours before it was dispatched by police; several people were arrested. [https://www.news.com.au/lifestyle/food/animal-activists-hold-protests-around-the-country-on-one-year-anniversary-of-confronting-documentary/news-story/4bce0ca02fa6c71f000638f5bf0379c9 (News.com.au)]
*[[Internet censorship in the United Kingdom]], [[Internet safety]]
**The [[Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport]] releases a white paper proposing to set up an independent regulatory body which would require Internet companies to remove content and block websites considered harmful. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-47826946 (BBC)]
*[[2019 college admissions bribery scandal]]
**Actress [[Felicity Huffman]] and 13 other defendants involved in a conspiracy regarding admission to prestigious colleges have agreed to plead guilty in the matter, prosecutors say. The 14 individuals are among 50 people accused of engaging in schemes that involved cheating on college entrance exams and paying $25 million in bribes to secure their children admission to well-known colleges. [https://wkzo.com/news/articles/2019/apr/08/felicity-huffman-others-to-plead-guilty-in-us-college-admissions-scandal-prosecutors/ (WKZO)]

;Politics and elections
*[[List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] fires [[Randolph Alles]], the [[Director of the United States Secret Service|Director]] of the [[United States Secret Service]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2019/04/08/politics/randolph-tex-alles-secret-service-director/index.html (CNN)]

;Science and technology
*[[David Saint-Jacques]] becomes the fourth Canadian astronaut to take part in a spacewalk and the first in 12 years as he begins a roughly seven-hour mission. [https://www.thespec.com/news-story/9272303-astronaut-david-saint-jacques-first-canadian-to-perform-spacewalk-in-12-years/ (TheSpec)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/david-saint-jacques-first-spacewalk-1.5088545 (CBC CA)]
